reading.zh: 47 个测试文件按“钉住哪件事”分组，顺序与程序实际运行一致：库 → 激活 → 配置（数据根自愈） → 启动 → DLSS5 → 崩溃 → 组件 → 运维，最后是面板注入链路（它要编译器，没有就 skip）。全部离线：路径都打到临时目录，**不碰**你真实的游戏目录与 runtime。
reading.en: 47 test files grouped by the subject they pin down, in the same order the program runs: library → activation → config (data-root self-healing) → launch → DLSS5 → crash → components → upkeep, plus the panel's injection link. Everything is offline: paths are patched into tmp dirs, nothing touches your real game folder or runtime.
